contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all three .sdata2 claims. Canonical entry calls contain floating-point literals, but these do not establish compiled section provenance, contents, or an eight-byte layout. No compiled evidence was supplied.

Accept deferral of the blue-crystal appearance claim. The aerial callback spawns numeric effect 0x4B7 on part 1's joint, sets the latch conditionally, and unconditionally installs hitlag callbacks and retires the accessory callback. Those operations do not identify the asset's appearance.

Accept deferral of the attenuation assertions in all three aerial-entry facts. Vertical velocity is reset and horizontal velocity is divided by an attribute without a local zero or magnitude guard. The document correctly describes division rather than guaranteeing attenuation.

Accept deferral of unconditional countdown-to-zero behavior. The canonical signed counter uses a nonzero test and subtraction, not a positive test or saturation. Negative values take the decrement branch; a tick changing 1 to 0 does not execute the falling call. Initialization from an attribute does not establish a valid nonnegative range.

unresolved: Compiled evidence is still required to establish .sdata2 size, contents, and literal provenance.
The horizontal-momentum divisor's actual values and valid range remain unverified.
The gravity-delay attribute's valid range remains unverified; normal countdown behavior cannot be generalized to negative signed values.
Effect 0x4B7's specific appearance requires asset or runtime evidence.

Effect destruction, latch reset, and full motion-state preservation semantics remain accepted cross-file lifetime deferrals. Acceptance covers the empty proposal and examined contradictions, not a new independent audit of every inherited retained fact or link.
